title: ExtensionByZeroOutside
statement: The corresponding inside/outside stalk property for extension by zero, as stated by the Lean declaration.

proof.text: This is the corresponding geometric stalk argument: sections vanish outside U, while neighbourhoods in U are cofinal and sheafification preserves stalks inside U. The unit map is then linear and natural.

lean.statement:
theorem module_extensionByZero_outside_stalk (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens) :
    let R := X.ringCatSheaf
    let P := SheafOfModules.extensionByZeroPresheaf.{u} R U
    let L := P ⋙ PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 R.obj)
    ∀ (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (R.over U)) (x : X), x ∉ U →
      IsZero (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (L.obj F).val.presheaf x)
